newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet ends touch firmer with futures, but quiet.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet ends touch firmer with futures, but quiet.

text.p: European jet was $1.00-$1.50 stronger on Tuesday on the back of firmer futures. Jet premiums were broadly steady.
April IPE gas oil last traded $1.50 stronger at $172.25 a tonne.
NWE barge premiums were assessed unchanged around April IPE gas oil +$17.50 fob while cargoes were put in the low $20s cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean EU spec was understood to be looking for high fob quotes +$8 while non-EU cargoes were pegged around high fob quotes +$4-5.
